question: Olympic Games 1952 were held in which of the following places?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Helsinki**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **1952 Olympic Games:-**

 
 
• **The 1952 Summer Olympics were the first to be held in Helsinki, Finland. (Hence option 3 is correct)**
 
• They were attended by over 4,900 athletes from 69 countries.
 
• The Games featured 149 competitions in 17 different sports.
 
• One of the biggest heroes of the 1952 Summer Olympics was Viktor Chukarin of the Soviet Union.
 
• Chukarin won four gold medals in gymnastics, including the all-around title. He also won a silver and a bronze medal.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Olympic Games:-**

 
 
• **These are the world's foremost international sporting event, featuring summer and winter sports competitions in which thousands of athletes from around the world participate in a variety of competitions. **
 
• The Games are considered the world's foremost sports competition with more than 200 teams, representing sovereign states and territories participating; by default the Games generally substitute for any World Championships the year in which they take place (however, each class usually maintains their own records).
 
• The next upcoming Olympic Games are:
 
 
• **2024 Summer Olympics:** Paris, France, from July 26 to August 11, 2024
 
• **2026 Winter Olympics:** Milan and Cortina d'Ampezzo, Italy, from February 6 to 22, 2026
